title: Storm surge
tldr: If a storm-surge evacuation order covers you, leave for a safe location outside the surge zone before roads close. Wind strength alone does not describe surge danger. Never walk or drive through coastal floodwater.
steps: Use your local emergency management evacuation map and official order.
Choose an inland destination outside the evacuation area and use designated routes.
Stay away from beaches, seawalls and flooded coastal roads.
Contact emergency services with your location and move to a safer higher level without entering a closed attic.
next: Return only after reentry is allowed; damaged bridges, debris and polluted water can remain.
watch: Storm surge may arrive before the worst wind. Do not wait for visible water.
review_status: source-linked editorial review; not independent expert certification
without_help: If you live in a surge zone, arrange an inland destination before the storm. Do not wait for public transport that has not been confirmed. Once roads are flooded, do not force a crossing; use the safest elevated location and signal if trapped.
household: Account for children, older people, pets and anyone who needs assistance before moving. Keep shoes, medicines and a torch in the shelter area. Decide who helps whom and who carries the essential supplies; do not send a lone child to retrieve items.
pack_now: Keep essential medicines, drinking water, a battery light, shoes, phone power and a written contact card within reach. Adapt the load to the hazard and the people with you; do not delay escape to collect equipment.
